title: Intravenous Thrombolysis In Acute Suspected Central Imbalance Or Vertigo
summary: The primary objective of this study is to systematically assess bleeding complications following intravenous thrombolysis in patients presenting with acute dizziness and suspected stroke. The secondary objective is to investigate prognosis and clinical course using clinical and instrumental assessment methods.
conditions: acute vertigo with suspected cerebrovascular etiology

interventions.name: Observation of bleeding complications following intravenous thrombolysis, as well as assessment of prognosis and clinical course using clinical scales and instrumental diagnostics (video-oculography, posturography, and orthoptic assessment).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Capacity to provide informed consent
- Presenting syndrome: acute vestibular syndrome, acute imbalance syndrome, or positional vertigo syndrome with suspected cerebrovascular etiology
- Premorbid modified Rankin Scale (mRS) score of 0-2
- Assessment of eligibility for intravenous thrombolysis completed
Exclusion criteria:
- acute intracranial arterial occlusion on emergency CTA anatomically consistent with the clinical syndrome
